name: Nimbus Granular
author: Ported from Mutable Instruments Clouds/Nimbus
description: Granular synthesis processor with real-time buffer recording, grain manipulation, and integrated reverb. Based on the classic Mutable Instruments Clouds module but simplified for CCAM Estuary.

knobs.name: Position
knobs.description: Playback position in the recorded buffer. At 12 o'clock, plays from current position. Turn clockwise to read from older material, counterclockwise for newer.

knobs.name: Size
knobs.description: Grain size/length. Controls how long each grain plays. Short grains create glitchy textures, long grains create smoother results.

knobs.name: Pitch
knobs.description: Pitch shift for grains. At 12 o'clock is no shift. Turn up for higher pitch, down for lower pitch.

knobs.name: Density
knobs.description: Grain triggering rate/density. Low settings create sparse, rhythmic textures. High settings create dense clouds of sound.

knobs.name: Texture
knobs.description: Spectral character and filter cutoff. Shapes the harmonic content of the granular output.

knobs.name: Dry/Wet
knobs.description: Balance between original (dry) and processed (wet) signal. Fully counterclockwise is dry only, fully clockwise is wet only.

knobs.name: Stereo Spread
knobs.description: Stereo width of grains. Low values keep grains centered, high values spread them across the stereo field.

knobs.name: Reverb
knobs.description: Amount of integrated reverb applied to the granular output. Adds space and ambience.

switches.name: Feedback
switches.description: Three-position switch controlling feedback amount. UP: high feedback (70%), CENTER: medium feedback (30%), DOWN: no feedback

switches.name: Freeze
switches.description: Two-position switch. UP: freeze buffer recording, DOWN: normal recording. When frozen, only existing buffer content is processed.

cv_inputs.name: Position CV
cv_inputs.description: CV modulation for playback position. ±1V range adds ±30% modulation to position parameter.

cv_inputs.name: Pitch CV
cv_inputs.description: CV modulation for pitch shift. ±1V range adds ±30% modulation to pitch parameter.

cv_inputs.name: Density CV
cv_inputs.description: CV modulation for grain density. ±1V range adds ±30% modulation to density parameter.

cv_inputs.name: Texture CV
cv_inputs.description: CV modulation for texture/filter. ±1V range adds ±30% modulation to texture parameter.

gate_inputs.name: Freeze Gate
gate_inputs.description: Gate input to freeze buffer recording. High gate freezes the buffer, low gate allows normal recording.

gate_inputs.name: Trigger Gate
gate_inputs.description: Gate input for manual grain triggering. Rising edge triggers a new grain.

gate_outputs.name: Freeze Status
gate_outputs.description: Gate output indicating freeze state. High when buffer is frozen, low when recording normally.

gate_outputs.name: Trigger Echo
gate_outputs.description: Gate output echoing the trigger input for chaining or monitoring.

cv_outputs.name: Position Out
cv_outputs.description: CV output of current position parameter (including modulation). ±5V range.

cv_outputs.name: Pitch Out
cv_outputs.description: CV output of current pitch parameter (including modulation). ±5V range.

usage_notes: Input signal is continuously recorded to a circular buffer unless frozen
Grains are triggered automatically based on density setting, or manually via trigger input
Each grain can have independent pitch, position, and stereo placement
Feedback creates regenerative delay effects by feeding output back to input
Freeze mode stops recording but continues granular processing of existing buffer content
CV inputs provide additional modulation beyond the knob settings
LEDs show parameter values and freeze state for visual feedback
tips: Start with position at 12 o'clock, size around 9 o'clock, and density around 10 o'clock
Use freeze to capture interesting moments and process them without new input
Combine pitch and texture modulation for evolving soundscapes
Higher density with smaller grain sizes creates more textural, less rhythmic results
The feedback switch dramatically changes the character - experiment with all positions
